text:
Marta: Quick sync  we need to decide on the edge assertion approach for tenant residency dark-launch today. Goal: active/active, steer legal tenants to EU infra without client changes.
Aj: Proposal: edge-only header X-RW-Residency: eu|na|none + an assertion fetched from control-plane. Edge only honors header when a signed assertion for tenant exists.
Chen: Two operational notes: 1) header spoofing if we trust client-sent header; 2) KV locality - routing to EU while KV lives in NA will spike p95.
sre-simon: Agree. Edge should cache signed assertions (short TTL). Need metrics: residency_assertion_miss, residency_misroute_count, residency_cache_local_miss. Also circuit-breaker to avoid flapping.
Aj: Example assertion (edge-cached): ```{"tenant":"acme-1","residency":"eu","enforce":true,"exp":"2026-04-15T12:00:00Z","sig":"base64"}``` Edge includes X-Res-Verified: <sig-id> when forwarding.
Marta: Legal asked for auditable events. legal-elaine: We need immutable residency_decision logs (tenant, edge-id, ts, decision, fallback) retained 90 days.
Chen: For KV, suggest hot-prefix replication to EU for residency tenants + cross-region read-forward for cold keys. Full geo-KV is too expensive. Will simulate amplification numbers.
sre-simon: Fallback policy options: strict (reject), degrade (route to standby EU or queue), best-effort (route to nearest). Default: degrade for paid, strict only with legal flag. Also cooldown 30s after reroute.
ops-ryan: deploy-bot: starting canary: residency-assertion-v1 -> 2% traffic. Canary id: c-1759. Pause on >0.5% error delta or +50ms p95.
Aj: During canary only honor assertions for tenants on opt-in allowlist. Edge will ignore client header otherwise.
Chen: I'll run a cache-miss simulation and post numbers tomorrow AM. Add metric residency_cache_local_miss to canary dashboard.
Marta: Action items: Aj -> PR with header + assertion protocol + edge pseudo-code + runbook. Chen -> replication playbook + sims. SRE-simon -> observability + canary guard rails. legal-elaine -> retention policy. ops-ryan -> watch canary and ready to rollback.
Marta: If canary stable for 4 hours, ramp to 20% then 50% over days. Any objections?
legal-elaine: Confirmed: include fallback logs for compliance.
sre-simon: I'll add automated alerts for misroute_count > 10/min and residency_cache_local_miss > threshold.
Marta: Thanks all. Keep messages short on the channel to avoid noise.
